query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

messages.content: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

message.content:
**Stephen, you’ve been one of our best engineers and a true legend on the team.** We’ll miss your sharp mind, great energy, and the memes that made even the busiest days better.

Wishing you an awesome next chapter—go build amazing things and keep the good vibes coming!
